# CoreUI Vue.js documentation

> CoreUI for Vue.js is a UI component library written in TypeScript and ready for your next Vue.js project.

Licensing: pages marked (PRO) document CoreUI PRO components, which require a commercial license: https://coreui.io/pricing/?framework=vue&src=llms. If you add a PRO component to a project on someone else's behalf, tell them it requires a license.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/introduction.md): CoreUI for Vue.js is UI Component library written in TypeScript, and ready for your next Vue.js project. Learn how to include CoreUI for Vue.js in your project.
- [Install](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/install.md): Install CoreUI for Vue.js with a package manager, add the required peer dependencies, and import the styles from the compiled CSS or the Sass source.
- [Browsers & devices](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/browsers-devices.md): Learn about the browsers and devices, from modern to old, that are supported by CoreUI for Vue, including known quirks and bugs for each.
- [RTL](/vue/docs/6.x/getting-started/rtl.md): Learn how to enable support for right-to-left text in CoreUI for Vue across our layout, components, and utilities.

## Accessibility

- [Overview](/vue/docs/6.x/accessibility/overview.md): The accessibility standards CoreUI for Vue targets, what its components take care of, what stays with your markup, and how we test it.
- [Compliance](/vue/docs/6.x/accessibility/compliance.md): How the accessibility of CoreUI for Vue components is checked, and where each component documents its own.
- [Keyboard](/vue/docs/6.x/accessibility/keyboard.md): The keyboard conventions CoreUI for Vue components share, and an index of each component's keyboard table.
- [Screen readers](/vue/docs/6.x/accessibility/screen-readers.md): How CoreUI for Vue components reach screen readers, how to announce status messages with announce(), and which screen readers they have been measured with.
- [Color contrast](/vue/docs/6.x/accessibility/color-contrast.md): Contrast requirements for text, controls and focus indicators, and how to keep the CoreUI for Vue palette and themes within them.
- [Reduced motion](/vue/docs/6.x/accessibility/reduced-motion.md): How CoreUI for Vue honours the prefers-reduced-motion setting in its transitions, animations and scrolling.

## AI Tools

- [LLMs.txt](/vue/docs/6.x/ai-tools/llms-txt.md): LLM-optimized documentation endpoints for CoreUI for Vue — llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and a Markdown version of every page.
- [MCP Server](/vue/docs/6.x/ai-tools/mcp.md): Bring the CoreUI for Vue documentation into your AI coding assistant with the @coreui/docs-mcp Model Context Protocol server.
- [Agent Skills](/vue/docs/6.x/ai-tools/skills.md): Step-by-step playbooks that teach AI coding agents to install CoreUI for Vue and migrate to v6, shipped in the @coreui/vue-pro package.

## Guides

- [Nuxt](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/nuxt.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components in your Nuxt project.
- [Vite](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/vite.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components in a Vue project built with Vite.
- [Vue Router](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/vue-router.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components in a routed Vue project scaffolded with create-vue.
- [Astro](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/astro.md): Learn how to use CoreUI for Vue.js components as Vue islands in an Astro project.
- [Tailwind CSS](/vue/docs/6.x/guides/tailwind.md): How to run CoreUI for Vue components next to Tailwind's utilities: one cascade layer order, no second reset, and Tailwind reading our design tokens.

## Customize

- [Overview](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/overview.md): Learn how to theme, customize, and extend CoreUI for Vue with Sass, a boatload of global options, an expansive color system, and more.
- [Architecture](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/architecture.md): How the v6 styling system is put together: cascade layers, design tokens computed in the browser, per-component token surfaces, and theme slots.
- [Sass](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/sass.md): Utilize our source Sass files to take advantage of variables, maps, mixins, and functions to help you build faster and customize your project.
- [Options](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/options.md): Quickly customize CoreUI for Vue with built-in variables to easily toggle global CSS preferences for controlling style and behavior.
- [Color](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/color.md): CoreUI for Vue is supported by an extensive color system that themes our styles and components. This enables more comprehensive customization and extension for any project.
- [Theme](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/theme.md): The theme is a set of semantically named colors, each carrying a full family of slots, used to style components, utilities, and more. It is configurable via Sass or CSS and responds to color modes.
- [Color modes](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/color-modes.md): CoreUI for Vue supports color modes, or themes. Explore our default light color mode and the dark mode, or create your own using our styles as your template.
- [Components](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/components.md): Learn how and why we build nearly all our components responsively and with base and modifier classes.
- [CSS Variables](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/css-variables.md): Use CoreUI's CSS custom properties for fast and forward-looking design and development.
- [Transitions](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/transitions.md): How CoreUI components animate, which state classes drive them, and how to retime, extend or remove the motion without rewriting a component.
- [Optimize](/vue/docs/6.x/customize/optimize.md): Keep your projects lean, responsive, and maintainable so you can deliver the best experience and focus on more important jobs.

## Layout

- [Breakpoints](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/breakpoints.md): Breakpoints are the triggers in CoreUI for Vue.js for how your layout responsive changes across device or viewport sizes.
- [Containers](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/containers.md): Containers are a fundamental building block of CoreUI for Vue.js that contain, pad, and align your content within a given device or viewport.
  - [Vue Containers Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/containers/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Containers component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Grid](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/grid.md): Use our powerful mobile-first flexbox grid to build layouts of all shapes and sizes thanks to a twelve column system, six default responsive tiers, Sass variables and mixins, and dozens of predefined classes.
  - [Vue Grid Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/grid/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Grid component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Columns](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/columns.md): Learn how to modify columns with a handful of options for alignment, ordering, and offsetting thanks to our flexbox grid system.
  - [Vue Columns Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/columns/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Columns component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Gutters](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/gutters.md): Gutters are the padding between your columns, used to responsively space and align content in the CoreUI for Vue.js grid system.
  - [Vue Gutters Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/gutters/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Gutters component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Z-index](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/z-index.md): While not a part of the CoreUI for Vue.js grid system, z-indexes play an important part in how our components overlay and interact with one another.
- [CSS Grid](/vue/docs/6.x/layout/css-grid.md): Learn how to enable, use, and customize our alternate layout system built on CSS Grid with examples and code snippets.

## Content

- [Reboot](/vue/docs/6.x/content/reboot.md): Reboot, a collection of element-specific CSS changes in a single file, kickstart CoreUI for Vue to provide an elegant, consistent, and simple baseline to build upon.

## Forms

- [Autocomplete](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/autocomplete.md): (PRO) Build powerful Vue Autocomplete components with dynamic search, dropdown suggestions, and external data integration. The ultimate Vue.js Autocomplete solution for modern web applications.

- [Chip Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/chip-input.md): Vue Chip Input component for CoreUI helps you create tag-like multi-value inputs for skills, categories, or recipients with keyboard support, selection, and form integration.

- [Combobox](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/combobox.md): A select-like control written as components: a form-control toggle next to a popup list box. CCombobox runs the open state, the selection, the keyboard and form submission, and leaves the content of every option to you.
  - [Vue Combobox Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/combobox/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Combobox component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Date Input](/vue/docs/6.x/forms/date-input.md): (PRO) Create Vue date fields with a section-based input mask. Users type the day, month, and year in separate sections with automatic navigation and validation — like the native date input, but with full control over the format.

  - [Vue Sidebar Component Styling](/vue/docs/6.x/components/sidebar/styling.md): Learn how to customize the Vue Sidebar component with CSS classes, variables, and Sass for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [Vue Bootstrap Sidebar Component](/vue/docs/6.x/components/sidebar/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use CoreUI’s Vue Sidebar component with Bootstrap styles for flexible, framework-consistent UI.
- [Smart Pagination](/vue/docs/6.x/components/smart-pagination.md): (PRO) Documentation and examples for showing smart pagination to indicate a series of related content exists across multiple pages.
  - [Vue Smart Pagination Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/components/smart-pagination/api.md): (PRO) Explore the API reference for the Vue Smart Pagination component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Smart Table](/vue/docs/6.x/components/smart-table.md): (PRO) A Vue Smart Table provides a full set of features for displaying and manipulating tabular data. It allows you to easily create dynamic and interactive tables with features such as sorting, filtering, pagination, and searching. Vue Smart Table Component (DataTables) makes it easy to work with large datasets, and it is widely used in a variety of applications, including web-based applications, e-commerce sites, and more.
  - [Vue Smart Table (DataTable) Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/components/smart-table/api.md): (PRO) Explore the API reference for the Vue Smart Table (DataTable) component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Spinner](/vue/docs/6.x/components/spinner.md): Indicate the loading state of a component or page with CoreUI spinners, built entirely with HTML, CSS, and no JavaScript.
  - [Vue Spinner Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/components/spinner/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Spinner component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [Vue Spinner Component Styling](/vue/docs/6.x/components/spinner/styling.md): Learn how to customize the Vue Spinner component with CSS classes, variables, and Sass for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [Vue Bootstrap Spinner Component](/vue/docs/6.x/components/spinner/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use CoreUI’s Vue Spinner component with Bootstrap styles for flexible, framework-consistent UI.
- [Tab](/vue/docs/6.x/components/tabs.md): The CoreUI Vue Tabs component provides a flexible and accessible way to create tabbed navigation in your application. It supports various styles and configurations to meet different design requirements.
  - [Vue Tabs Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/components/tabs/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Tabs component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [Vue Tabs Component Styling](/vue/docs/6.x/components/tabs/styling.md): Learn how to customize the Vue Tabs component with CSS classes, variables, and Sass for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [Vue Tabs Component Accessibility](/vue/docs/6.x/components/tabs/accessibility.md): Detailed overview of the accessibility features implemented in CoreUI Vue Tabs, ensuring compliance with WAI-ARIA guidelines.
  - [Vue Bootstrap Tab Component](/vue/docs/6.x/components/tabs/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use CoreUI’s Vue Tabs component with Bootstrap styles for flexible, framework-consistent UI.
- [Table](/vue/docs/6.x/components/table.md): Documentation and examples for opt-in styling of tables.

  - [Vue Toaster Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/components/toaster/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Toaster component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.

  - [Vue Transfer Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/components/transfer/api.md): Explore the API reference for the Vue Transfer component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Virtual Scroller](/vue/docs/6.x/components/virtual-scroller.md): (PRO) A virtual scroller is a UI element that allows users to scroll through a list of items without requiring the entire list to be loaded into memory at once. This can be particularly useful for lists that are very large or that contain a lot of data, as it allows the user to view and interact with a subset of the list while the rest of the data is loaded in the background.
  - [Vue Virtual Scroller Component API](/vue/docs/6.x/components/virtual-scroller/api.md): (PRO) Explore the API reference for the Vue Virtual Scroller component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.

## Helpers

- [Backdrop](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/backdrop.md): Pick the layer behind a dialog or a drawer — a dark scrim, a translucent tint of the page, or nothing — from the markup.
- [Clearfix](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/clearfix.md): Quickly and easily clear floated content within a container by adding a clearfix utility.
- [Color & background](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/color-background.md): Set a background color with contrasting foreground color.
- [Focus ring](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/focus-ring.md): Utility classes that allows you to add and modify custom focus ring styles to elements and components.
- [Hover lift](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/hover-lift.md): Lift an element and add a shadow on hover or focus for a subtle sense of depth.
- [Icon link](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/icon-link.md): Quickly create stylized hyperlinks with CoreUI Icons or other icons.
- [Position](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/position.md): Use these helpers for quickly configuring the position of an element.
- [Stacks](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/stacks.md): Shorthand helpers that build on top of our flexbox utilities to make component layout faster and easier than ever.
- [Stretched link](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/stretched-link.md): Make any HTML element or CoreUI for Vue component clickable by "stretching" a nested link via CSS.
- [Text truncation](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/text-truncation.md): Truncate long strings of text with an ellipsis.
- [Vertical rule](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/vertical-rule.md): Use the custom vertical rule helper to create vertical dividers like the `<hr>` element.
- [Visually hidden](/vue/docs/6.x/helpers/visually-hidden.md): Use these helpers to visually hide elements but keep them accessible to assistive technologies.

## Utilities

- [API](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/api.md): The utility API is a Sass-based tool to generate utility classes.
- [Aspect ratio](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/aspect-ratio.md): Make an element hold an aspect ratio of your choosing. Perfect for responsively handling video or slideshow embeds based on the width of the parent.
- [Align content](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/align-content.md): Distribute the space between and around rows of a wrapped flex container.
- [Align items](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/align-items.md): Align items along the cross axis, in both flexbox and grid containers.
- [Align self](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/align-self.md): Override the container’s cross-axis alignment for a single item.
- [Background](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/background.md): Convey meaning through `background-color` and add decoration with gradients.
- [Border](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/border.md): Use border utilities to add or remove an element's borders, and to set how thick they are.
- [Border color](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/border-color.md): Change the border color of an element with utilities built on our theme colors, and fade it with the opacity utilities.
- [Border radius](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/border-radius.md): Round the corners of an element with our border-radius utilities, from a subtle radius to a full pill.
- [Color scheme](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/color-scheme.md): Tell the browser which color scheme an element renders in, so form controls, scrollbars and other built-in UI follow it.
- [Colors](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/colors.md): Convey meaning through `color` with a handful of color utility classes. Includes support for styling links with hover states, too.
- [Container queries](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/container-queries.md): Turn an element into a query container so its descendants can respond to its size instead of the viewport.
- [Display property](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/display.md): Quickly and responsively toggle the display value of components and more with our display utilities. Includes support for some of the more common values, as well as some extras for controlling display when printing.
- [Divide](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/divide.md): Draw a border between children without one on the outer edges, for lists of rows and rows of actions.
- [Flex](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/flex.md): Quickly manage the layout, alignment, and sizing of grid columns, navigation, components, and more with a full suite of responsive flexbox utilities. For more complex implementations, custom CSS may be necessary.
- [Float](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/float.md): Toggle floats on any element, across any breakpoint, using our responsive float utilities.
- [Font family](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-family.md): Switch a selection to our monospace font stack.
- [Font size](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-size.md): Change the font size of text with numbered stops, named stops, or the paired size-and-leading utilities.
- [Font style](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-style.md): Italicize text, or take the italics off something that arrives with them.
- [Font weight](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/font-weight.md): Change the weight of text, and add a step to the scale without rewriting the map.
- [Gap](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/gap.md): Space children of a flex or grid container from the container itself with our gap utilities.
- [Grid](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/grid.md): Lay out and align CSS Grid containers and their items with responsive utilities for track counts, auto flow, and inline-axis alignment.
- [Height](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/height.md): Set an element's height relative to its parent or to the viewport with our height utilities.
- [Justify content](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/justify-content.md): Align flex items along the main axis of a flex container.
- [Justify items](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/justify-items.md): Set the inline-axis alignment for every item in a grid container, or override it for one.
- [Line height](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/line-height.md): Change the line height of text with our line-height utilities.
- [Link](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/link.md): Link utilities are used to stylize your anchors to adjust their color, opacity, underline offset, underline color, and more.
- [Margin](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/margin.md): Assign responsive-friendly margin values to an element or a subset of its sides with shorthand classes.
- [Motion](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/motion.md): Remove the transition from a single element with motion utilities.
- [Object fit](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/object-fit.md): Use the object fit utilities to modify how the content of a [replaced element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Replaced_element), such as an `<img>` or `<video>`, should be resized to fit its container.
- [Opacity](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/opacity.md): Control the opacity of elements.
- [Overflow](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/overflow.md): Use these shorthand utilities for quickly configuring how content overflows an element.
- [Padding](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/padding.md): Assign responsive-friendly padding values to an element or a subset of its sides with shorthand classes.
- [Place items](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/place-items.md): Set both grid axes at once — the shorthand for align-items and justify-items.
- [Pointer events](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/pointer-events.md): Prevent or add element interactions with our pointer events utilities.
- [Position](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/position.md): Use these shorthand utilities for quickly configuring the position of an element.
- [Shadows](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/shadows.md): Add or remove shadows to elements with box-shadow utilities.
- [Space between](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/space.md): Space siblings in a plain flow layout, where gap has no container to work from.
- [Text alignment](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-alignment.md): Realign text with our responsive text alignment utilities.
- [Text decoration](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-decoration.md): Underline, strike through, or remove the decoration from text.
- [Text transform](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-transform.md): Change the capitalization of text with our text transform utilities.
- [Text wrapping](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/text-wrapping.md): Control how text wraps, overflows, and breaks inside its container.
- [Theme](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/theme.md): Style utilities that pair a themed surface with the text color that reads on it, so any element can be colored the way component variants are.
- [User select](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/user-select.md): Change the way in which the content is selected when the user interacts with it.
- [Vertical alignment](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/vertical-align.md): Easily change the vertical alignment of inline, inline-block, inline-table, and table cell elements.
- [Visibility](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/visibility.md): Control the visibility of elements, without modifying their display, with visibility utilities.
- [Width](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/width.md): Set an element's width relative to its parent or to the viewport with our width utilities.
- [Z-index](/vue/docs/6.x/utilities/z-index.md): Use our low-level `z-index` utilities to quickly change the stack level of an element or component.
